page_title: ARS 2-2 FUL | Arsenal v Fulham 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Paul Tierney is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Kenny Tete (Fulham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+10' Arsenal have a corner.
90+10' The referee signals a corner kick to Arsenal.
90+10' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal and forces the goalkeeper to make a great save.
90+9' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but Bernd Leno punches the ball away.
90+9' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90+8' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Arsenal.
90+8' A cross into the box from Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) is cleared.

90+7' Adama Traore (Fulham) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
90+7' It's a free kick to Arsenal, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+6' A player from Fulham brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
90+5' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
90+5' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+4' Arsenal are ruled offside.
90+4' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
90+2' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) plays a through ball but overhits it.
90+1' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Declan Rice will be replaced by Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal).
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
89' Substitution. Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) has come on for Harrison Reed.
87' 2 - 2 Joao Palhinha (Fulham) meets a cross from a well-taken corner kick and fires home. His effort goes into the bottom left corner and hits the net.
87' Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
86' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
84' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Jorginho (Arsenal) replaces Martin Odegaard.
83' An infringement by Calvin Bassey (Fulham) results in a yellow card and as it's the second time today, he also sees a red and is dismissed by Paul Tierney.
82' The referee awards a corner and Harrison Reed (Fulham) goes over to take it.
82' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
81' The ball is cleared after Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
81' Issa Diop (Fulham) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
80' Mikel Arteta (Arsenal) gets a yellow card, off the field.
80' Adama Traore (Fulham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
78' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
77' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
74' Although Marco Silva (Fulham) is just on the bench, Paul Tierney has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
74' Having seen unsporting behavior, Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Marek Rodak (Fulham) is the recipient.
72' 2 - 1 Goal! Fabio Vieira puts a cross into the box and finds Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal), who latches on to it and strikes the ball low into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:1.
71' Here is a change. Harry Wilson is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Adama Traore (Fulham).
70' Substitution. Sasa Lukic is replaced by Harrison Reed (Fulham).
70' 1 - 1 Goal! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Bernd Leno.
69' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
67' Kenny Tete (Fulham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Paul Tierney stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. PENALTY AWARDED to Arsenal!
66' The game is interrupted. Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.

64' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
63' That will be all from Andreas Pereira who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Tom Cairney (Fulham).
63' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
63' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.
58' A long pass finds Martin Odegaard (Arsenal), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies low towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno reacts well to make a good save.
58' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
57' The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
56' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) replacing Kai Havertz.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thomas Partey leaves the pitch and Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) comes on.
56' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
55' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
55' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Arsenal.
54' The ball is out of play. Fulham will have a throw-in.
53' The linesman signals that Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
52' Great individual play by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) ends with a shot from distance that flies well wide of the right post.
50' It's a yellow card for Calvin Bassey (Fulham).
50' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
50' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

48' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) bursts inside the box, beats two defenders and produces a strike from the penalty spot. The shot has power, but lacks precision and the goalkeeper stops it easily. The scoreline remains the same.
47' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Mikel Arteta gives a chance to Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) and Leandro Trossard is off.
46' The whistle blows and Paul Tierney starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The ball is cleared after Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
44' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) collects a pass and has an effort from distance to the top left corner, but Bernd Leno answers with a superb save to deny him.
41' A goal, which was scored by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal), was disallowed due to offside.
41' Great touch by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
40' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
39' A long ball forward to Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is intercepted.
38' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
36' The Arsenal players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
35' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) plays a through ball but overhits it.
34' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
33' The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
33' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
32' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Arsenal.
32' Bernd Leno pulls off a great save to deny Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
31' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), whose header goes wide of the goal.
31' Arsenal are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
29' Harry Wilson (Fulham) sends a cross in and finds Andreas Pereira inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
28' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) makes a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
26' A long-range effort by Harry Wilson (Fulham) after he received a good pass was well wide of the right post.
26' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
23' Fulham force a corner. They send men into the box.
22' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Aaron Ramsdale scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
22' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
21' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

21' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) controls the ball from the free kick and from the edge of the box unleashes a strike. If it hadn't been blocked by one of the defenders it could have ended up inside the right post.
20' Arsenal have been awarded an indirect free kick.
19' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
19' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
19' The ball is out of play. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner.
18' A pass by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

18' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno made a crucial save!
16' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Antonee Robinson (Fulham), but the defence gets it clear.
15' Paul Tierney blows his whistle after Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
14' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
14' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
13' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
11' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) controls a cross inside the box and sends a shot towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort.

11' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Arsenal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
10' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
9' Arsenal are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
8' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
6' A lofted cross from Thomas Partey (Arsenal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
5' Harry Wilson (Fulham) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
5' The ball has crossed the sideline. Arsenal are taking a throw-in.
4' Good movement by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
3' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
1' 0 - 1 GOAL! Andreas Pereira (Fulham) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
1' The match has just started.
